scoring_justification: Direct recomputation from the provided mean lag-time data yields sigma values ~0.7 erg/cm^2 away from the paper's reported gold, because the paper's linear regression used individual measurements with scatter. Therefore the checker compares agent's sigma to the paper's reported values with a tolerance (1.0 erg/cm^2) that allows for the difference, achieving full reward for a genuine re-run while still requiring the correct procedure.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for apparent interfacial free energy sigma_control and sigma_citrate
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: Results section and Fig. 2 caption. "Apparent interfacial energy for the control was 28.9 erg cm^{-2}, and for the citrate system it was 26.8 erg cm^{-2}."
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly taken from the paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual results, not invented.

outputs.description: Apparent interfacial free energies for control and citrate conditions, derived from Gibbs-Thomson analysis of nucleation lag-time data.

output_contract.notes: The checker will independently recompute sigma from the same input data and constants, and compare the submitted values within an absolute tolerance. No other artifacts are required.
